alex chen: Hey @people-ops — planning to work from Tallinn ~2024-06-15 to 2024-10-15 (about 4 months). Quick checklist Qs before I book: 1) Is WFH stipend prorated for a multi-month temporary homebase? 2) Any payroll/tax nexus risk for Redwood for ~120 days in Estonia? 3) Can corporate laptop be shipped to my temporary address (VAT/customs concerns)? 4) Will benefits (health/pension) stay active while I'm abroad? Who should I file with? :slightly_smiling_face:
maya (people-ops): Thanks Alex. Please submit a Temporary Homebase form (link in bio) — stipend is prorated by calendar days for partial months. Payroll/legal need to confirm Nexus — we'll triage once you submit. For equipment, choose "international shipment" on the form so our vendor handles PO/VAT if possible. Benefits are usually continuous but can vary by country.
alex chen: Filed the form and attached partner's permit. Temporary address included. Short add: role will be infra/platform work, no planned client meetings or recruiting on the ground.
sanjay (payroll): Thanks — FYI: under ~90 days many countries are low risk, but Estonia can be fuzzy around 90-180 days depending on activities. We'll run a payroll nexus check once legal completes advisory. Don't change bank details until payroll confirms.
nora (legal): Looping legal in. Note: Estonian tax residency is typically 183+ days, but employer obligations can arise earlier (PE or social security) if work is performed locally for local clients or you establish a presence. We'll open an advisory with our tax partner — please confirm you won't be meeting customers or hiring locally.
alex chen: Confirm no customer meetings or local hiring; internal infra work only. OK to route shipping via vendor.
logistics-team: If you select "international ship" we'll attempt to use corporate PO and vendor-managed import to minimize VAT. If vendor cannot ship due to export controls or stock, you can request a personal-ship pre-approval for expense reimbursement (attach invoices).
maya (people-ops): Next steps: 1) legal opens ticket with tax advisor (nora) 2) payroll runs nexus check (sanjay) 3) logistics confirms shipping feasibility. We'll update this thread by EOD. If you need to sign a lease before checks finish, DM me for a provisional note but it's at your own risk until tax/payroll confirm.
alex chen: Thanks — will hold off on lease until we get explicit go/no-go. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
